sentences.arabic: الشهر اللي فات رحنا رحلة العلا.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: الشَّهر اللي فات رُحنا رِحلة العُلا.
sentences.english: Last month we went on a trip to Al-Ula.
sentences.transliteration: ish-shahr illi faat ru7na ri7la il-3ula.

sentences.arabic: نزلنا في فندق صغير قريب من البلدة القديمة.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: نِزِلنا في فُندُق صُغَيَّر قَريب مِن البَلدة القَديمة.
sentences.english: We stayed at a small hotel near the old town.
sentences.transliteration: nizilna fi funduq sughayyar gareeb min il-balda il-gadeema.

sentences.arabic: شفنا مقابر الحجر وأخدنا صور كتير.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: شُفنا مَقابِر الحِجر وأخَدنا صُوَر كِتير.
sentences.english: We saw the ancient tombs of Hegra and took a lot of photos.
sentences.transliteration: shufna magaabir il-7ijr w-akhadna suwar kteer.

sentences.arabic: بالليل قعدنا تحت النجوم في البر.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بالليل قَعَدنا تَحت النُّجوم في البَر.
sentences.english: At night we sat under the stars in the desert.
sentences.transliteration: bil-lail ga3adna ta7t in-nujoom fi il-barr.

sentences.english: It was a lot of fun; we had a great time!

sentences.arabic: يوم الجمعة سويت طلعة مع عيلتي.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: يوم الجُمعة سَوّيت طَلعة مَعَ عيلتي.
sentences.english: On Friday I went on an outing with my family.
In the morning we visited a museum in Al-Balad.
Then we went to the amusement park, and the kids had fun.
In the evening we had dinner on the corniche.

scenario.situation: The student is back at work after a long weekend and a Jeddawi colleague asks about their trip around Saudi Arabia.
scenario.otherRole: The curious Jeddawi colleague, who recommends more places to visit.
scenario.goalEnglish: Describe where you went, where you stayed and what you did, say whether you had fun, and ask for recommendations for your next trip.
